# Spotify attribution asset

`Spotify_Full_Logo_RGB_Black.svg` is the unmodified official black RGB full logo
from Spotify's 2024 developer design-resource archive:

https://developer.spotify.com/images/guidelines/design/2024-spotify-full-logo.zip

It is used only to attribute metadata returned by Spotify. Spotify is a trademark
of Spotify AB; its inclusion does not imply endorsement of Media Downloader.

Usage must continue to follow Spotify's current Design & Branding Guidelines:

https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/design
